title: Topic 17
japanese_text: 小学校でクラス担任をしていたとき、子どもたちは<u>無邪気で</u>明るく仲も良かったが、授業中の<u>私語</u>が多すぎるため、<u>説教した</u>ことがあった。特に騒いでいた子どもには、<u>罰</u>として校庭を１０周走らせたこともあったが、今ではこれは<u>体罰</u>に該当するのでしてはならない。
english_translation: When I was a class teacher at an elementary school, most of the children were innocent, cheerful, and friendly, but I did have to lecture them because they whispered too much during class. I once made a particularly disruptive child run 10 laps around the school grounds as punishment, but this would now be frowned upon as corporal punishment.
